title: Assign hits on a phone, and X-89 Bacterial Weapon in the bombardment card
description: The staged hit assignment panel (space combat, Space Cannon, ground combat) no longer clips its + and Sustain buttons at 390 px: two-line rows, 44px targets, a sticky confirm bar. The bombardment result now shows the doubling of X-89 Bacterial Weapon. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on 80ce1bf1; fixtures are synthetic states through the mocked server.

shots.heading: Space combat hits (sustain stage, 5 hits), phone 390x844: before
shots.caption: Base 80ce1bf1: the row grid is seven fixed columns; on a phone the + and Sustain buttons are clipped off the right edge (unreachable), the name wraps one word per line and the Confirm bar scrolls away with the list.

shots.heading: Space combat hits (sustain stage, 5 hits), phone 390x844: after
shots.caption: Two-line rows: name and hint on top, a full-width row of 44px -, Sustain and + below. A sticky bar keeps '5 of 5 left', Auto-assign, Reset and Confirm hits on screen. No horizontal scroll (asserted).

shots.caption: Per-shooter '2 x 2 = 4 hits', a line 'X-89 Bacterial Weapon: each hit counts as 2. 2 rolled hits = 4 hits to assign', and the result sentence says '2 hits from 3 dice, each counted twice (X-89 Bacterial Weapon): 4 hits'.

notes.title: Engine:
notes.text: X-89 Bacterial Weapon already doubles bombardment and ground combat hits in the engine (invasion.rs x89_multiplier) and exhausts the bombarded planet; only the web display was wrong. The coexistence target question already states the doubled hit count.
